  "cons": [
    "Performance issues or slower load times compared to Squarespace",
    "SEO capabilities felt less robust than desired for growth",
    "Customer support response times could be inconsistent"
  ],
  "overall_experience": "This founder found Wix to be a solid platform for creating their e-learning website, appreciating its design flexibility and wide array of features. While generally satisfied with the ease of use for initial setup, they experienced some frustrations with site performance and felt the SEO tools were not as effective as hoped. The value proposition was good, though support could sometimes be slow, leading to a generally positive but not overwhelmingly enthusiastic recommendation."
